replication.target_description: Study 1c: indirect relative-preference camp-size main effect versus direct-comparison extension; supplied generic valuation description does not distinguish these tests, and summary and main-text effect sizes disagree.

notes: Identity: supplied canonical text contains the matching Numbing or Sensitization? title, Ziano, Xiao, Yeung and coauthors including Feldman; identifies itself as in press at Journal of Experimental Social Psychology, accepted August 18, 2021, and names all five assigned replication studies. Source URL identifies an author-hosted preprint-final PDF. This is a full primary author manuscript with supplementary material, not an abstract or secondary report. The journal DOI is not printed in the inspected title matter, so exact published-version identity is not independently established. No PDF was supplied; no rendering or acquisition performed. Manuscript page numbers differ from supplied journal-page locators. Only assigned unfinished fields populated; all other fields are placeholders, not absence determinations. Candidate evidence: main indirect camp-size effect F(1, 436) = 42.44, p < .001, η2p = 0.09, 90% CI [0.05, 0.13] (p. 32); equivalence subgroup n = 309: F(1, 308) = 20.63, p < .001, η2p = 0.06. Table 13 (p. 52) instead prints Study 1c η2p = 0.12 [0.08, 0.17], and abstract p. 1 prints 0.13 [0.08, 0.17]. Direct-comparison extension (p. 34) t(436) = −19.93, p < .001, d = −0.95; equivalence subgroup t(308) = −15.10, p < .001, d = −0.86. No target selected and no conversion performed.
